# Weapon demo assets

The playable pistol uses the model, hands, textures, and animation clips from **Makarov PM FPS animations** by Cransh (Sketchfab: @ccransh):
https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/makarov-pm-fps-animations-d02ebd58e3cf44acb7af73e3f156be28

The source description also credits the Makarov PM model to Martin Trafas (@Bexxie) and the FPS hands to @bumstrum.

**Animated Pistol** by JUST (Sketchfab: @teenjust500) is included as an alternate source asset:
https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/animated-pistol-415cd71f76c24d1b914f367ba9d5fcf4

Both models are licensed under [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). The Unity scene uses the Makarov model with new URP materials; the original animation data and texture files are retained.
